title: Four Rebounds Cut the Alleged Bribe to $70K, Feds Say

lines.say: Four rebounds. Prosecutors say that one stat cut Terry Rozier's alleged bribe from a hundred thousand to seventy thousand dollars.
lines.show: Four rebounds. Prosecutors say that one stat cut Terry Rozier's alleged bribe from $100,000 to $70,000.

lines.say: He left the game after nine minutes. Points, assists, threes: all under the betting lines.
lines.show: He left the game after nine minutes. Points, assists, threes: all under the betting lines.

lines.say: But four rebounds went over. Some bets lost. So, the superseding indictment alleges, the bribe was negotiated down.
His lawyers say the same stat shows he played hard, the opposite of what bettors wanted.
He pleaded not guilty. So who's right? Tell me below.
